waveform.time_axes: Same linear time scale in both windows; widths proportional to 5.70 s and 1.90 s; 1-s tick spacing.
waveform.annotation: Numbered stages and First seizure / Termination / Second seizure share one text baseline; connected X axis with a central smooth wave.

header.termination_label_location: Schematic header near the right end of the first segment, left of the gap; actual 17.2 s lies in the omitted interval, not at the viewport edge 13.8 s.

time_axis_connector.style: Straight connector with a smooth central wave

waveform.onset_source: Author waveform review: exclude the transient near 8.7-8.8 s and near 59.2 s.

waveform.stage_selection: Illustrative native 20-ms frames after the author-selected onset, retaining Local/Spread/Entry/Ictal semantics.
waveform.stage_5_note: Local reactivation is in the surround; both cores have zero spikes in this 20-ms frame.
waveform.numbered_stage_markers: 1-4 and 5-8 mark the two entries; no numbered termination state.
